summary: Compute a floored poloidal-field magnitude and a median reference magnitude from radial and axial components on the caller's R-Z grid.

identity.relation: poloidal magnetic-field components to magnitude and median reference
identity.direction: B_R and B_Z -> B and B0_default
identity.definition: B = max(hypot(B_R,B_Z), 1e-30 T) pointwise; B0_default is the median of the floored, finite B array.
identity.model: Euclidean magnitude of cylindrical poloidal-field components with a maintained numerical floor
identity.coordinates: cylindrical radial and axial components, arrays indexed [Z,R]
identity.boundary: A zero field is represented by the 1e-30 T numerical floor, not physical zero.
assumptions: Both components have matching SI tesla units and grid coordinates.
The 1e-30 T floor is a numerical convention, not a measured field.

inputs.name: br
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonempty two-dimensional array; same shape as bz.

inputs.name: bz
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonempty two-dimensional array; same shape as br.

outputs.name: B
outputs.constraints: Finite and at least 1e-30 T for accepted inputs whose magnitude fits float64.

outputs.name: B0_default
outputs.description: Median of the returned B values for use as a caller-selected reference field.
outputs.constraints: Finite, at least 1e-30 T, and derived from all returned grid values.

preconditions: Both arrays represent co-located cylindrical poloidal-field components in tesla and share the same [Z,R] indexing.
supported: Finite component arrays on a nonempty two-dimensional grid.
excluded: Toroidal component or total magnetic-field magnitude.
A physical inference that the field is nonzero where the floor is active.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for mismatched or non-2-D shapes, nonfinite components, empty grids, or a computed magnitude beyond finite float64 range.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unexpected NumPy execution errors propagate; no fallback magnitude is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iteration is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial dictionary is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel relation mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 operator and its direct tests. The historical admission mapping is development provenance only, not approval in the current SciRel lifecycle.
source_kinds: saved L1 operator document and implementation

example.description: Measure one 3-4-5 field point and one zero component pair.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import compute_poloidal_field_magnitude
result = compute_poloidal_field_magnitude([[3.0, 0.0]], [[4.0, 0.0]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['B'], [[5.0, 1e-30]])
assert result['B0_default'] == 2.5
example.expected: B is [[5, 1e-30]] T and B0_default is 2.5 T.

scope: 3-4-5 magnitude, zero floor and median reference.
Shape mismatch, empty grid and unrepresentable magnitude rejection.
Large finite component and median arithmetic regressions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests cover the arithmetic and selected floating-point boundaries of this maintained relation; they do not establish a model-specific physical interpretation of the reference median or expert recognition of the development record.
known_limitations: The returned median is a default numerical reference, not an independently determined physical scale.
The fixed floor replaces exact zero in B.
